name: Household altar or shrine
definition: cabinet, shelf or box shrine kept in a home or room to hold sacred images, name tablets or talismans.

name: Shrine boundary rope
definition: rope hung to mark a sacred space or object.

name: Devotional panel painting
definition: sacred picture painted on a rigid panel, framed or mounted to stand or hang.

name: Devotional scroll painting
definition: sacred picture painted or printed on cloth or paper and mounted as a hanging scroll or rolled for hanging.

name: Altarpiece
definition: large sacred picture or carved screen made to stand behind or above an altar.

name: Devotional statue
definition: sculpted figure of a holy person, deity or saint made to be venerated; the figure is not a kind.

name: Devotional cross
definition: cross, with or without a figure on it, made to stand, hang or be held in veneration.

name: Nativity set
definition: boxed or composed set of figures and a stable that shows the birth of Jesus, sold and compared as one set.

name: Relic
definition: body part or belonging of a holy person, or a thing touched to one, kept for veneration.

name: Reliquary
definition: case or container made to hold and show a relic.

name: Prayer beads
definition: string or loop of beads, knots or counters made to count prayers, with or without a cross, tassel or guide bead.

name: Prayer rug
definition: rug or mat made to kneel, stand or prostrate on in prayer.

name: Prayer wheel
definition: cylinder holding written prayers, turned by hand, wind or water.

name: Prayer flag
definition: cloth flag printed with prayers or sacred images, hung to be blown by the wind.

name: Devotional medal
definition: loose medal of a saint or sacred subject made for devotion.

name: Prayer card
definition: printed card with a sacred image or prayer, kept or carried for devotion.

name: Holy-water font
definition: small basin for holy water, hung or stood by a door or in a room.

name: Holy-water bottle
definition: bottle or flask made to hold blessed water.

name: Carried protective charm
definition: small charm carried (not worn as jewellery) for luck, protection or a named blessing.

name: Ritual cup
definition: cup or goblet made to hold wine or another drink used in a rite.

name: Monstrance
definition: display vessel with a window or frame, made to show a consecrated host.

name: Ritual food plate
definition: plate or tray made to hold the symbolic foods of a rite.

name: Aspergillum
definition: sprinkler for holy water.

name: Torah pointer
definition: slim rod ending in a pointing hand, held to follow the text when reading a scroll aloud.

name: Ritual sceptre
definition: short sceptre held in the hand in a rite.

name: Ritual knife
definition: knife or blade made to be held in a rite, not to cut.

name: Doorpost scroll case
definition: case made to hold a doorpost scroll and be fixed to a doorpost.

name: Doorpost scroll
definition: handwritten parchment strip of sacred text made to be put in a case and fixed to a doorpost.

name: Phylacteries
definition: pair of small boxes holding handwritten sacred passages, with straps, made to be strapped to the arm and head in prayer.

name: Handwritten Torah scroll
definition: handwritten scroll of the Five Books on parchment, made to be read in the rite.

name: Ritual horn
definition: horn or shell made to be blown in a rite.

name: Hand bell
definition: bell held by a handle and rung in a rite or service.

name: Standing bowl bell
definition: bowl-shaped bell that rests on a cushion or stand and is struck with a striker, made for a rite.

name: Slit drum
definition: hollow wooden block struck to keep rhythm in chanting.

name: Hanukkah lamp
definition: nine-branch lamp or candle holder, eight places for the festival lights and one for the helper light.

name: Seven-branch menorah
definition: seven-branch lamp or candle holder.

name: Oil lamp for worship
definition: lamp burning oil or ghee, made for worship.

name: Eternal light
definition: lamp kept burning before a sanctuary or altar.

name: Altar candlestick
definition: candle holder made to stand on or by an altar in a rite.

name: Ritual candle
definition: candle made for a rite or devotion, including altar, votive, procession, grave and memorial candles.

name: Advent wreath
definition: wreath with candles used to count the weeks before Christmas.

name: Ritual lantern
definition: lantern made to be hung or set out in a rite or as a shrine offering.

name: Ritual incense
definition: incense made for a rite, in stick, cone, resin or church grade.

name: Incense burner
definition: standing or hanging vessel for burning incense.

name: Swung censer
definition: incense burner hung on chains, to be swung.

name: Offering vessel
definition: bowl, cup or vase made to hold water, rice, tea, flowers or other offerings.

name: Offering stand
definition: stand or tray made to hold offerings.

name: Tarot deck
definition: 78-card deck with major and minor suits, sold for divination.

name: Oracle deck
definition: deck of cards with its own set of images and messages, any number of cards, sold for divination.

name: Lenormand deck
definition: 36-card deck of the Lenormand pattern, sold for divination.

name: Crystal ball
definition: sphere used for scrying.

name: Spirit board
definition: lettered board with a pointer, made for divination.

name: Rune set
definition: set of stones, wood or tiles marked with runes, made for casting.

name: I Ching coin set
definition: coins or sticks made for casting the I Ching.

name: Divination pendulum
definition: weight on a chain or cord, made to be dangled for divination.

name: Coffin or casket
definition: box that holds a body for burial or cremation.

name: Cremation urn
definition: container for cremated remains, of any capacity from a keepsake portion to a companion pair; not a worn piece of jewellery.

name: Scattering urn
definition: container made to release ashes on land, water or from the air.

name: Urn vault
definition: outer box or liner made to hold an urn in the ground.

name: Grave marker
definition: stone or plaque set on or at a grave.

name: Memorial tablet
definition: tablet that stands for a dead person, inscribed with a name, kept at an altar or home.

name: Funeral pall
definition: cloth laid over a coffin.

name: Burial shroud
definition: cloth or set of cloths that wrap the body.

name: Torah finial
definition: ornament fitted to the top of a scroll's rollers.

name: Coffin plate
definition: plate fixed to a coffin, naming the dead.

name: Coffin pillow
definition: pillow made for the inside of a coffin.

name: Urn appliqué or medallion
definition: plaque, appliqué or medallion made to be fixed to an urn.
